title: A Probabilistic U-Net for Segmentation of Ambiguous Images
mechanism: A conditional VAE prior/posterior pair over a latent code gives a distribution of plausible masks from a U-Net.
adaptation: Reference baseline for the multi-rater family and the base of the D-Persona arm. Use the latent code to represent trace placement ambiguity.
min_experiment: Included only as the multi-rater baseline in the benchmark suite. No standalone arm.
evidence: R: LIDC-IDRI and Cityscapes; well-calibrated sample distributions (abstract).
